Hot water comes from an electric geyser (storage water heater). The switch is on the wall outside the bathroom door. **Switch it on about 30 minutes before you need hot water.** A timer automatically cuts the power after 2 hours, so switch it on again if you need more. Geyser sizes: Studio 35 litres, One-Bedroom 50 litres, Two-Bedroom 80 litres, Penthouse two 80-litre units. After heavy use, allow about 30 minutes for reheating. The filtered water dispenser in the kitchen has two taps: blue for cold and red for hot. The hot tap has a child-lock: press and hold the safety button while you press the tap.
